sources.title: Redacto: keep personal data out of your AI prompts
sources.snippet: Keep personal data out of your AI prompts. Redacto finds names, emails, phone numbers, addresses, IBANs and BSNs, swaps them for neat placeholders like [Name#1], and restores the real values in the AI's reply.
